title.en: An Act to Appropriate Funds for Public Works and Permanent Improvements in the Mountain Province and the Province of Nueva VIzcaya.

text.en:
There are hereby appropriated, out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise
appropriated, for the fiscal year ending December thirty-first, nineteen hundred and seventeen, the following
sums or so much thereof as may be respectively necessary:
For public works and permanent improvements in the Mountain Province, as follows:
Construction, repair, and maintenance of roads and bridges, in the discretion of the Secretary of Commerce
and Communications . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
Maintenance and repair of the Naguilian Baguio highway . . . . .
45,000.00
Construction and repair of schools, hospitals, and public buildings for provincial governments, and for other
purposes, in the discretion of the Secretary of the Interior . . . . . . . . . . . . .
50,000.00
For public works and permanent improvements in the Province of Nueva Vizcaya, in the discretion of the
Secretary of Commerce and Communications . . . . . . . . . . . . . .
50,000.00
275,000.00

All balances of the several appropriations made by this Act unexpended on June thirtieth,
nineteen hundred and eighteen, shall revert to the unappropriated funds in the Insular Treasury and thereafter
shall not be available for withdrawal or expenditure except upon appropriation by the Legislature.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, March 9, 1917.
